description: This Java source file defines the ConstantFuture class, a concrete implementation of the java.util.concurrent.Future interface that always represents a completed future with a fixed value.

classes.name: ConstantFuture
classes.description: A generic class implementing Future that always returns a constant value and is always considered completed without cancellation.

methods.name: ConstantFuture
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ConstantFuture with a fixed value.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Always returns false; the future cannot be canceled.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the stored value after a timeout; since the value is constant, it returns immediately.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Always returns false; the task cannot be canceled.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Always returns true; the future is always considered completed.
